title: Begone, Powdered Snow
description: Prevents powder snow from spawning during worldgen without removing the block completely.
body:
### Begone, Powdered Snow!

We all know the feeling.  One moment you're traipsing casually through the snowy slopes, the next you're at the bottom of an icy pit of misery.  _Oh no!  You forgot to bring your leather boots!_

Begone, Powdered Snow overrides powder snow spawns to be normal snow during worldgen.  However, it does not remove the block from the game entirely, meaning it can still be collected from cauldrons and placed by hand if you happen to have need of it.  Win-win!

_Begone, Powdered Snow removes powder snow from biomes which use vanilla or Terralith's default powder snow rule.  Worldgen mods and datapacks that do not use these rules may still spawn powder snow.  Test carefully if you are unsure!  Oh the Biomes You'll Go and Biomes O'Plenty appear to work as intended._

_Made on request of several long-suffering community members._
